recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-13412 unless a new CDS work group decision reopens whether PlanDefinition should gain a separate CDS Hooks-specific label element.
issue_request: FHIR-13412 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification CDS work group request for STU3 PlanDefinition. It asked to rename PlanDefinition.action.label to PlanDefinition.action.prefix and initially suggested adding a separate label field for CDS Hooks; the accepted resolution changed label to prefix but left the existing title element rather than adding label.
initial_application: The request was applied in SVN 12257, mirrored as git commit dc518ae740cffce38c76fcc4d296a1b6b7f66fc8, which changed PlanDefinition.action.label to PlanDefinition.action.prefix and updated PlanDefinition examples away from the old label element. Later source refactors preserved the prefix element in the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: PlanDefinition is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The current source contains PlanDefinition.action.prefix followed by PlanDefinition.action.title, and searches found no remaining PlanDefinition.action.label path or PlanDefinition action label element. Later same-artifact issue FHIR-27037 updated PlanDefinition.action/title descriptions for R5 pharmaceutical quality examples but did not reverse the prefix/title distinction. Zulip and Confluence searches found no substantive community discussion conflicting with the Jira and source history; Zulip only returned the bot notification for the original SVN-backed commit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already implements the accepted resolution: the old action label element is gone, action.prefix exists for the numbering/prefix use case, and action.title remains the display title instead of introducing a CDS Hooks label element.

related_jiras.note: Later Published PlanDefinition action wording update; it changed descriptions but preserved the prefix/title structure relevant to FHIR-13412.
